proof_body:
by
  intro f a b n hab hf
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_taylor_mean_remainder_bound hab hf
  refine ⟨C, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have h := hC x hx
  rw [taylor_within_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  have hs : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a b) a / (k.factorial : ℝ) * (x - a) ^ k = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ * (x - a) ^ k) • iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a b) a := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hs]
  exact h
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ), a ≤ b → ContDiffOn ℝ (n + 1) f (Set.Icc a b) → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f x - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a b) a / (k.factorial : ℝ) * (x - a) ^ k| ≤ C * (x - a) ^ (n + 1)
